title: Sorting Qty ascending lists negative parts first, in parentheses, with a dash for Margin %
custom_preconds:
• Several tracked parts whose bins net below zero (e.g. -86, -8, and one with bins -14/4/4/3).
  • Reports > Inventory Value, As of today, one location.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Qty header (ascending).
  2. Read the first rows and the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Negative rows come first, lowest first.
  • Qty, Margin, Total Sell and Total Cost show in parentheses, e.g. (-3.00) and (-$276.39).
  • A part with bins -14/4/4/3 shows (-3.00), not 11.

Step 2:

  • Each negative row shows “—” for Margin %.
  • The Totals row includes the negative rows.
